Hi Corey, 
my apologies, this is a bug. I changed the package on github and it should now hopefully avoid the problem. I didn't test it, so please let me know if it is solved. 
Note that the camera operation matrix will not be saved in the zip. I will change that in July. 
Best,
Jürgen
